description: On the table in front are a purple scoop, a light blue bowl with a small white piece inside, a yellow squeeze-bottle toy, a wooden spatula, and a red plastic fork. The right hand reaches forward toward the bowl, dips in to grasp the small white piece as a right-hand object, lifts it up, then moves left and lowers it into the purple scoop before releasing; the left hand stays low and open near the red fork without touching anything.
